title: New trailer for my multiplayer catnip mowing game
author: sorryaboutyourcats
selftext:
Hey y'all! I recently added features to Mow Meow, like eyes (how did the cats see before?!), a quest an email system, and lots of quality of life features.

The trailer on the page has been the same one since the early access Steam launch last year, so it was time for a new one and here it is.

Game was made mostly with Sonnet and Opus, and the music from the trailer is from Suno.

Okay that's it. 😸

Thanks! The process I took:

1. Procrastinate updating the game trailer for months  
2. Get annoyed that current trailer on Steam is more than a year old, even though updates happened  
3. Trap yourself in your office for an entire day without your phone, with nothing but Premiere Pro open

Job done!
